payload.answer: làm tốt nhất có thể, không giới hạn cự ly

payload.text: D1: scope re-aimed to the shared main checkout's .githooks/pre-commit hook, not merge.mjs's mergeRunnerItem (already correct, already refuses .fgos/ diffs, predates the incident, and is unreachable by a manual git merge run outside fgos approve -- confirmed: e921fdb4 has zero fgos-engine event, and the pre-commit hook's 3 existing checks all scope to fgw/* branches or full-deletions only, never firing when HEAD=main and a commit modifies .fgos/*.jsonl content)
payload.rationale: see CONTEXT.md / docs/history/tsk-1i3-merge-content-precedence-overwrite/RESEARCH.md for full scout evidence

payload.text: D2: guard scope is content-precedence, not parent-count -- applies to ANY commit landing on the main checkout's own default branch that touches .fgos/*, not narrowed to merge commits specifically. A single-parent commit (e.g. the periodic checkpoint auto-commit) is trivially compliant since it only appends, so scoping by parent count would add complexity the invariant itself does not need
payload.rationale: see CONTEXT.md / RESEARCH.md for scout evidence

payload.text: D4: acceptance bar is a cheap, synchronous-hook-safe heuristic (e.g. per-file line-count non-decrease for .fgos/*.jsonl) -- it does not need full semantic/content-hash correctness, which would cost real latency on every commit. It only needs to catch the class of regression already observed (bulk content loss, e.g. events.jsonl losing 352 lines), not every theoretical malformed-but-same-length edit. The exact comparison mechanism is fgos-coding-planning's call
payload.rationale: see CONTEXT.md / RESEARCH.md for scout evidence

payload.text: D3: hard refuse, with no bypass flag -- matches the item's own original ask and the track record (2 confirmed real data-loss incidents from adjacent guard gaps, tsk-1vc and this incident). Unlike tsk-1ji's opportunistic checks (detect-and-warn, chosen because they run on every claim/return call and a false positive would block legitimate high-frequency work), this guard sits on the rare commit-time path for the main checkout only, so the false-positive-blocking-legitimate-recovery cost that justified detect-and-warn elsewhere is much weaker here
payload.rationale: see CONTEXT.md / RESEARCH.md for scout evidence

payload.description:
Opportunistic-checks auto-staging (không commit) làm fgos catchup/approve tự va vào chính nó, luôn refuse "local changes would be overwritten" -- khác tsk-2f6 (đã delivered, về fgos-write-rejected's unconditional content-check trên merge đã stage sạch). Bug này chưa bao giờ tới được bước đó: git tự chặn PRE-merge vì working tree DIRTY.

Root cause xác nhận trực tiếp (đêm nay, tsk-1i3's merge, 7 lần lặp y hệt trước khi tìm ra): runOpportunisticMainCheckoutChecks (src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs, gate bằng FGOS_DISABLE_OPPORTUNISTIC_CHECKS, gọi từ merge.mjs:788 và :911 bên trong mergeRunnerItem/performCatchUp) làm git add (STAGE, không chỉ ghi working tree) lên .fgos/events.jsonl như một phần của periodic-checkpoint logic của chính nó. Một diff đã STAGE (khác working-tree-only) trên path có .gitattributes merge=union khiến git's own pre-merge dirty check refuse BẤT KỲ git merge --no-commit --no-ff nào sau đó chạm path đó -- xác nhận bằng scratch-repo cô lập: cùng nội dung, nếu chỉ nằm ở working tree (chưa git add) thì merge thành công (no-op, vì branch's content vốn là ancestor/subset); nếu đã git add thì merge luôn fail với "local changes would be overwritten", bất kể quan hệ nội dung.

Approve's own code (src/verbs/merge/approve.mjs:302, recordIronLawAcknowledge) cũng ghi 1 decision event mới vào .fgos/events.jsonl ngay TRƯỚC lần merge attempt của chính approve call đó -- việc ghi này không idempotent, luôn chạy fresh mỗi lần gọi --acknowledge-iron-law. Kết hợp cả 2 cơ chế: catchup đồng bộ branch xong, approve tự ghi + tự merge trong CÙNG 1 lời gọi, y hệt cấu trúc self-collision deterministic, không phải timing race -- lặp lại y hệt 7 lần liên tiếp đêm nay, không hề hội tụ dù retry bao nhiêu lần, chỉ dừng khi set FGOS_DISABLE_OPPORTUNISTIC_CHECKS=1 cho cả catchup và approve (đúng env var npm test's own test script đã dùng để tránh chính vấn đề này).

Đề xuất fix: (a) runOpportunisticMainCheckoutChecks nên COMMIT ngay sau khi stage (không để staged-nhưng-chưa-commit làm bẫy cho lệnh git khác chạy ngay sau), hoặc (b) approve/catchup nên tự set FGOS_DISABLE_OPPORTUNISTIC_CHECKS=1 nội bộ quanh chính bước git merge của mình (không phụ thuộc caller nhớ set), hoặc (c) recordIronLawAcknowledge nên ghi SAU khi merge đã stage sạch, không phải trước.

Riêng biệt, đã tự tìm+tự sửa+đã merge một bug thứ 2 liên quan trong đêm nay (không cần track thêm, chỉ ghi lại làm bằng chứng): tsk-1i3's own content-precedence guard (.githooks/pre-commit, hàm stagedFgosModificationsRegressLineCount) gọi execFileSync('git',['show',...]) đọc blob .fgos/events.jsonl (10MB+) mà không set maxBuffer, vượt default 1MB của Node, khiến MỌI commit chạm .fgos/events.jsonl trên main bị refuse nhầm "could not read blob". Đã fix (maxBuffer: 200MB) tại commit e2affe8c, đã push.

payload.title: Worktree-isolation guard refuses fgos-coding-driving's own documented pane-rename command,…
payload.description: Worktree-isolation guard refuses fgos-coding-driving's own documented pane-rename command, silently defeating pane-labeling on every driving-loop invocation inside a worktree. references/loop-mechanics.md Step 5 prescribes running exactly bash plugins/fgOS/skills/terminal/rename.sh "<id>" "$PWD" on every stage-skill invocation. Confirmed live during tsk-2y1's drive (2026-08-23): the identical script ran successfully from the main checkout before EnterWorktree (plain /fgOS:pick step 3, no $PWD variable, absolute path arg), but the exact same script invoked with "$PWD" from inside the worktree-isolated session (fgos-coding-driving Step 5, right before loading fgos-coding-discovering) was refused with this command is too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree. Likely cause: the guard cannot statically verify a path behind an unresolved $PWD shell variable, so it refuses generically rather than resolving/allowing it. Per the pane-rename call's own hard rule (never stop, retry, or branch on its result -- decoration, never a gate), the drive continued correctly, but the practical effect is that pane relabeling silently no-ops on every single fgos-coding-driving Step 5 call made from inside a worktree-isolated session -- i.e. every item after the first /fgOS:pick-level rename never gets its pane relabeled again as it moves through stages, defeating the mechanism's whole purpose (a person watching herdr panes can no longer tell which item/stage a pane is on after the first stage). Fix direction: either have the isolation guard special-case this specific rename.sh invocation shape (or resolve $PWD before the guard's complexity check), or have loop-mechanics.md's Step 5 pass an already-resolved absolute path instead of the literal $PWD token.

payload.description: bug: sync-root.mjs's defensive guard (sync-root-unhandled-outcome, blocks reporting false 'synced' when mergeRunnerItem returns an unrecognized outcome) has no regression test anywhere in the current test suite. tsk-1cp's own doc claims coverage at test/cli/fgos.test.mjs:6374, but that file does not exist in the current tree -- confirmed via test -f and grep -rl 'sync-root-unhandled-outcome' test/ (no hits anywhere). Likely stale citation from a later refactor that moved this code from bin/fgos.mjs into src/verbs/merge/sync-root.mjs (sync-root.mjs:147-167, if (result.outcome !== 'merged')) without updating the doc. Real gap: a guard that exists specifically to prevent sync-root from silently reporting success on a merge that never actually landed has zero test protection today. Found while implementing tsk-2qp (approve lock guards merge/commit); out of that item's own scope so not fixed there. Fix: add a regression test exercising sync-root's outcome-guard with an unrecognized mergeRunnerItem outcome (e.g. reuse the new lock-lost-mid-merge outcome tsk-2qp just added, or a synthetic unknown one) asserting sync-root reports an error/blocked result, never 'synced'; correct the stale doc citation in tsk-1cp's own explanation doc to point at the real current location.
